title: Anonymous Letters Received By Miss Ursula Paelz, German

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.I, Special Branch
REPORT
Date May 4, 1939.
Subject: Anonymous letters received by Miss Ursula PAELZ, German.
Made by J.S. Pitts Forwarded by C. Crawford S.I.

With reference to the contents of the undated
letter from Mr. S. LAHRMANN, leader of the local Nazi
group, requesting that enquiries be made into the
identities of the writers of two anonymous
communications received by Miss Ursula PAELZ, there
appears every reason to believe that letter II was
the work of a Jewish immigrant, since the type of
postcard used cannot be procured in Shanghai and is
of the kind brought from Germany by a number of
refugees.

It has not been found possible to ascertain
the writer's identity for the simple reason that
samples of handwriting of at least 8,500 refugees
would have to be first secured for purposes of
comparison. Several of the newcomers are in the
daily habit of perusing the advertising columns of
the North-China Daily News in the offices of that
journal at 17 The Bund and although some of them have
been observed taking written notes it has not been
found practicable to secure any specimens of their
writing.

Mr. LAHRMANN was interviewed on May 3 in
connection with this affair and he declared that the
employment of the term "Only Arians" by Miss PAELZ
when inserting the advertisement was a most unwise
one, that as far as he was concerned the matter was
closed and that there was no need for his communication
to be answered.

D.C. (Special Branch)
Da. Pitts -
D. S.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别科（S.I, Special Branch）
报告
日期：1939年5月4日。
事由：德国籍乌苏拉·佩尔茨（Ursula PAELZ）小姐收到的匿名信件。
制作人：J.S. 皮茨（J.S. Pitts） 转呈人：C. 克劳福德（C. Crawford），特别科督察。

关于当地纳粹团体负责人 S. 拉尔曼（S. LAHRMANN）先生那封未注明日期的来信内容，该信请求调查收到乌苏拉·佩尔茨小姐的两份匿名通讯的作者身份，现有充分理由相信，第二封信系一名犹太移民所为，因为所使用的明信片类型在上海无法购得，而是许多难民从德国带来的那种。

由于简单的原因，即为了进行比较，首先必须获取至少8,500名难民的笔迹样本，因此查明作者身份已被证明是不可能的。几位新来者习惯于每天在外滩17号《字林西报》报社办公室阅读广告栏，虽然观察到其中一些人在做书面笔记，但发现获取他们的笔迹样本并不可行。

5月3日，就此事约谈了拉尔曼先生，他宣称，佩尔茨小姐在刊登广告时使用“仅限雅利安人”一词是极不明智的，就他而言，此事已了结，无需回复他的去函。

副总监（特别科）
致 皮茨 -
D. S.

〔此处转录不清：左侧边缘手写批注及“FILE”印章〕

Letter No 1.

Ich schreibe im Auftrage eines Englaender. Sie haben eine
Anonce in der Zeitung fuer Arier. Sie Schwein,Betrueger,
Strolch,Bastard.. Kein Mensch sondern ein Tier welches auf-
gefressen werdeb muss. Vergessen Sie nicht dass Sie in China
sind wo man Sie im lebenden Koerper verbrennen muss!!!
Mein Freund wird schon ausfindig machen wo Sie wohnen,aber
dann gnade Ihnen Gott. Sie wagen es nicht mal ihren Nahmen
aufzuschreiben. Wenn Sie Kinder haben und sie auch nach dem
verrueckten Hitler aufwachsen lassen,sollen selbige umkom-
men im Dreck,was sie Sauerkraut gewoehnt sind. Ein Kuli ist
mir lieber als ihre ganze dreckige Gesellschaft.. Noch ein
mal, Sie sind in China und Asien,sehen Sie sich for, for uns
und alle Anhaenger welche alle Communisten sind und die Ihnen
den Hals so gerne abschneided wie Hitler es tuht,aber bei Ihren
Anhaengern noch viel schneller.

Louis Lenhouse,
14 Nazie Road, Honkong.


Translation

I am writing on behalf of an Englishman. You have in-
serted an advertisement in the newspaper looking for an Ari-
an. You swine,cheat,vagabond,bastard...You are not a human
being,but a beast who should be devoured. Do not forget that
you are in China where you should be burnt alive!!! My
friend will find out where you live ,and then God help you..
You dare not give your name... If you have children and let
them grow up in the spirit of crazy Hitler,may they perish in
shit,to what you Sauerkraut are used.. I prefer a coolie to
the whole your filthy society. Once more- you are in China
and Asia, be careful of us and of all followers who are all
communists and who will chop off your heads with the same plea-
sure as Hitler,but much quicker.

Louis Lenhouse(?)
14 Nazie Road, Hongkong.

译文

我代表一位英国人写信。你在报纸上刊登了一则寻找雅利安人的广告。你这头猪、骗子、流浪汉、杂种……你不是人，而是一头应该被吞食的野兽。别忘了你在中国，在这里你应该被活活烧死！！！我的朋友会查出你住在哪里，然后上帝保佑你……你甚至不敢写下你的名字……如果你有孩子，并让他们在疯狂的希特勒的精神下成长，愿他们死在粪便中，就像你们这些酸菜习惯的那样……比起你们整个肮脏的社会，我更喜欢一个苦力。再说一次——你在中国和亚洲，小心我们以及所有追随者，他们都是共产主义者，他们会像希特勒那样愉快地砍掉你的头，但速度要快得多。

路易斯·伦豪斯（Louis Lenhouse(?)）
香港纳齐路14号。

Letter No.2

Na Sie dreckige Sau wissen Sie nicht dass Sie in China sind
Wenn Ich erfahre wo Sie wohnen ,werde Ich Sie mal besuchen.
Ihre ganze Familie soll daran glauben Sie sind Arsch,Scheisse
sind Sie. Aber warten Sie mal,Ich werde von mir hoeren lassen.
Sie Ausschuss der Menschheit,verlumpte Gesellschaft.. Ihre
ganze Gesellschaft soll sich nicht breit machen.
....................Genosse Toter Hund.

Translation

Well you dirty beast, don't you know that you are in
China? When I find out where you live I will pay you a call.
Your whole family should believe it. You are arse,shit,that's
what you are. But wait a little,you will hear from us. You
scum of humanity, you rotten crowd.. All of you should not
spread yourselves out here... .........
Comrade Dead Dog.

译文

喂，你这头脏猪，难道你不知道你在中国吗？当我查到你住在哪里时，我会去拜访你。你全家都该信这个。你是屁股，你是屎，这就是你。但是等着瞧吧，你会听到我们的消息。你这个人渣，你这群烂人……你们这群人都不该在这里招摇____
同志“死狗”。

S. LAHRMANN.
REPRESENTATIVE OF THE
GERMAN STATE RAILWAYS' TRAVEL OFFICE.
TELEGRAMS "NAMRAL"

TELEPHONE 14806
P. O. BOX 1172
97. JINKEE ROAD.
SHANGHAI

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGIST.
No. S. B. D. 2007
Date ____）

To the
Superintendent
of the Shanghai Municipal Police,
185 Foochow Road,
Shanghai.

Sir,

Miss Ursula Paelz, 300 Great Western Road, has
inserted an advertisement in the issues of the
"North China Daily News" of Saturday and Sunday the
22nd and 23rd inst. respectively.
The advertisement reads as follows:
"May 1, nicely furnished south room with private
bath and verandah. Near Columbia Country Club.
With or without board. (Only Arians.) Please
address Box 3055, NCDN."
She has received the enclosed two anonymous and
slanderous writings under covers addressed to above
Chiffre c/o the North China Daily News.
Would you please go into the matter and find
out who the writers of these letters are. Evidently
they are emigrants from Germany who object to the
reference to "Only Arians" in the advertisement.

Yours faithfully,

Lahrmann

S. 拉尔曼。
德国国家铁路局旅行办事处代表。
电报挂号：“NAMRAL”

电话 14806
邮政信箱 1172
上海静安寺路97号。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别科登记。
编号 S. B. D. 2007
日期 ____）

致
上海公共租界工部局警务处总监，
上海福州路185号。

先生，

乌苏拉·佩尔茨小姐，大西路300号，已于本月22日（星期六）和23日（星期日）分别在《字林西报》上刊登了一则广告。
广告内容如下：
“5月1日起，南向房间，家具齐全，带独立浴室和阳台。靠近哥伦比亚乡村俱乐部。可包膳或不包膳。（仅限雅利安人。）请寄《字林西报》3055号信箱。”
她收到了附上的两封匿名且诽谤性的信件，信封地址为上述代号，由《字林西报》转交。
恳请贵处调查此事，并查明这些信件的作者是谁。显然，他们是来自德国的移民，反对广告中提及“仅限雅利安人”。

此致
敬礼，

拉尔曼
